title: Maximal Rectangle in 2D Matrix

monster.name: Tessellation Sphinx
monster.title: Examiner of Continuous Ones
monster.defeatQuote: Histogram DP on each row yielded the largest solid rectangle!

description: Given a `rows x cols` binary `matrix` filled with `0`'s and `1`'s, find the largest rectangle containing only `1`'s and return its area.
solutionCode:
def maximalRectangle(matrix: list[list[str]]) -> int:
    if not matrix or not matrix[0]: return 0
    cols = len(matrix[0])
    heights = [0] * cols
    max_area = 0
    def get_max_hist(h):
        st = []
        area = 0
        arr = h + [0]
        for i, v in enumerate(arr):
            while st and arr[st[-1]] > v:
                height = arr[st.pop()]
                w = i if not st else i - st[-1] - 1
                area = max(area, height * w)
            st.append(i)
        return area
    for row in matrix:
        for j in range(cols):
            heights[j] = heights[j] + 1 if row[j] == '1' else 0
        max_area = max(max_area, get_max_hist(heights))
    return max_area

def maximalRectangle(matrix: list[list[str]]) -> int:
    if not matrix or not matrix[0]: return 0
    cols = len(matrix[0])
    heights = [0] * cols
    max_area = 0
    def get_max_hist(h):
        st = []
        area = 0
        arr = h + [0]
        for i, v in enumerate(arr):
            while st and arr[st[-1]] > v:
                height = arr[st.pop()]
                w = i if not st else i - st[-1] - 1
                area = max(area, height * w)
            st.append(i)
        return area
    for row in matrix:
        for j in range(cols):
            heights[j] = heights[j] + 1 if row[j] == '1' else 0
        max_area = max(max_area, get_max_hist(heights))
    return max_area
